source: Items are all dishes she has cooked and posted. priceSource says where each number came from: 'hers' = a price she published herself (see research/menu-extracted.md); 'market' = a Philadelphia going-rate we set for a dish she never priced publicly, or a refresh of a price she posted years ago. EVERY 'market' price needs Daija's sign-off before it is treated as final - see docs/price-sheet.md.
